'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Shinile train collision]]
**At least 14 people are killed and dozens of others are injured when an overcrowded train full of merchants crashes into a stationary train near [[Dire Dawa]] in [[Oromia Region]], [[Ethiopia]]. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Attempted assassination of Robert Fico]]
**A [[Slovakia|Slovak]] court sentences 72-year-old Juraj Cintula, the perpetrator in the [[attempted assassination]] of [[Prime Minister of Slovakia|prime minister]] [[Robert Fico]] in 2024, to 21 years in prison. Cintula continues to deny the accusations, saying he aimed away from [[vital organs]]. [https://apnews.com/article/slovakia-trial-fico-assassination-verdict-5f1c61fe91750bed7eb4b193366b93d1 (AP)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c051mj72ddjo (BBC News)]
*[[Irish anti-immigration protests]]
**[[Riot]]ing takes place in [[Dublin]], [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], with several thousand [[Opposition to immigration|anti-immigration]] protesters attempting to storm a hotel housing [[asylum seeker]]s in the city after the alleged rape of a 10-year-old Irish girl by an asylum seeker. A [[Garda Síochána|police]] vehicle is set on fire during the unrest. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c629zg8v8jpo (BBC News)]
*[[Poland–Ukraine relations]], [[Romania–Ukraine relations]], [[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
**A [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] citizen is detained in [[Poland]] and two others are arrested in [[Romania]] for allegedly working for [[Russia]]n [[Intelligence agencies of Russia|intelligence agencies]] and preparing acts of [[sabotage]] on Ukrainian shipping routes. [https://apnews.com/article/poland-sabotage-war-ukraine-hybrid-russia-b62581c88b125d18b6f962c0c0b83b2f (AP)]
*A [[Colombia]]n [[Judiciary of Colombia|court]] overturns a [[bribery]] conviction against former [[President of Colombia|president]] [[Álvaro Uribe]], who had been sentenced to 12 years of [[house arrest]] in August 2025. The court is still considering further appeals on a [[fraud]] charge. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/colombian-court-strikes-down-former-presidents-bribery-conviction-2025-10-21/ (Reuters)] [https://www.dw.com/en/colombia-court-overturns-uribe-witness-tampering-conviction/a-74448191 (DW)]

*[[Peruvian political crisis (2016–present)]]
**[[Peru]]vian [[President of Peru|president]] [[José Jerí]] declares a 30-day [[state of emergency]] in [[Lima]] in an attempt to curb rising [[Crime in Peru|crime]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-declares-30-day-state-emergency-lima-tackle-rising-crime-2025-10-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sanae Takaichi]] is elected as [[Japan]]'s first female [[Prime Minister of Japan|prime minister]] by the [[House of Representatives (Japan)|House of Representatives]] after her party, the [[Liberal Democratic Party (Japan)|Liberal Democratic Party]], agreed to form a [[coalition government]] with the [[Japan Innovation Party]].
